scope: Deterministic bounded page-image regression, discovered during live image quality investigation

before.failure: OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C ssize_t
before.location: read_page_range_images eagerly constructed list(range(...)) before slicing

change: Slice the lazy range before iteration; keep existing page order/count ceiling and 144 DPI rendering.
limitations: Synthetic integer boundary, not a claim that M3 emitted this value in a live run.
Does not bound PDF page pixel dimensions or improve image recognition.
